setup.title: Set up your home
setup.intro: Tell us who lives here and which spots need extra care. You can change this anytime.

setup.name: Name

setup.offline: Setup saves to the server. Check your connection: {msg}

landing.headline: Your child’s day, in your care.
landing.sub: Kanaf turns your home camera into a calm picture of the day: time on every screen, how much they moved, and the few moments worth a look. All in one place.
landing.ages: For parents of children aged 3 to 12

features.title: Every screen, counted
features.text: TV, tablet and phone, and the time spent on two at once.

features.title: How much they moved
features.text: Active play, light movement and long still stretches, next to the WHO goal for their age.

features.title: A few moments worth a look
features.text: Falls, a visit to a spot you marked, or rough play. Flagged with a short clip for you to judge.

landing.howSub: Computer vision does the watching, so you only read the result.

steps.title: Add a video, or go live
steps.text: Upload a recording from your home camera, or use your webcam.

steps.title: We find people and screens
steps.text: Each child is tracked as a body outline. TVs, tablets and phones are found around them.

steps.title: The day becomes a timeline
steps.text: Screens, movement and moments, minute by minute. No full video is kept.

steps.title: You check a few moments
steps.text: Short clips of anything worth a look. You decide what it was.

privacy: Children are tracked as body outlines, the same lines you see on this page.
The full video is never stored. Only short clips of flagged moments.
Every flag is a question for you, not a verdict about your child.
Delete any day, clip or child at any time.
landing.footer: A computer vision project, Tuwaiq Academy 2026

adv.title: What we'd suggest
adv.byAi: Written by Claude from these numbers only (no video leaves Kanaf). Not medical advice.
adv.byRules: Written from these numbers. Not medical advice.

review.text: {name} has moments you haven't looked at yet: {list}. A quick look takes a minute.

fall.title: After the fall
fall.text: If {name} seemed hurt, or falls keep happening, a pediatrician can take a look. Export the report to show them.

rough.title: Rough play
rough.text: {name} had {n} rough play moments. Talk about taking turns. If it keeps happening, a child counselor can help.

multi.title: One screen at a time
multi.text: {name} used two screens at once for {time}, {pct}% of screen time. One screen at a time is easier to follow and to stop.

moveLow.title: Room to move more
moveLow.text: {name} was active for {active} of the {seen} we saw. A short game or a walk helps toward 60 active minutes a day.

moveGood.title: Good moving
moveGood.text: {name} was active for {active} of the {seen} we saw. Keep the play going.

still.title: Break up long sits
still.text: The longest still stretch was {time}. A short stretch or walk every half hour helps.

drink.title: Drinking
drink.text: {name} was seen drinking for {time}. Keeping water close helps on active days.

keep.title: Keep a copy
keep.text: Export this report to keep it, or to share it with family or a specialist.

wScreen.title: Screens
wScreen.less: {name} averaged {avg} a day on screens, {pct}% less than last week. Whatever changed is working.
wScreen.more: {name} averaged {avg} a day on screens, {pct}% more than last week. Screen-free times, like meals, can help.

wGoal.title: 60 active minutes
wGoal.good: {name} reached 60 active minutes on {n} of {days} days. {best} was the most active day.
wGoal.low: {name} reached 60 active minutes on only {n} of {days} days. {best} was the best day: what happened then is worth repeating.

adv.wMulti: {name} used two screens at once for {pct}% of screen time this week. One screen at a time is easier to follow and to stop.

wMoments.title: {n} moments this week
wMoments.open: {n} of them are still waiting for you. A quick review keeps nothing important missed.
wMoments.done: You've reviewed them all. If the same kind keeps coming back, a specialist can look at the report.

mTrend.title: Four-week trend
mTrend.text: Over four weeks, {name}'s screens went from {s1} to {s2} a day, and active play from {a1} to {a2}.

mWeekend.title: Weekends
mWeekend.text: Screens are {pct}% higher on the weekend ({we} a day against {wd}). A weekend outing or game can balance it.

mScreen.less: {name} averaged {avg} a day on screens, {pct}% less than last month.
mScreen.more: {name} averaged {avg} a day on screens, {pct}% more than last month.

adv.mGoal: {name} reached 60 active minutes on {n} of {days} days with video, and had {moments} moments this month. Export the month to keep a record.

rep.specialistText: This report shows patterns in {name}'s day from a home camera: time on screens, movement, and moments flagged for a parent to check. Children are tracked as body outlines only. It is a record to support a conversation, not a diagnosis.
rep.notesHint: What you noticed, and what you'd like to ask.
